assay: bulk RNA-seq of FACS-sorted spinal cord nuclei (NeuN+ and NeuN- fractions), SMART-Seq HT, STAR + featureCounts (S9.16.p1, S9.18.p1, GEO data_processing)
sample_inclusion: EAE mice at peak of disease; AAV8-GFP n=3 vs AAV8-irisin-Flag n=3; NeuN+ and NeuN- nuclei from each animal (FIG4 b,c; FIG10)
primary_estimand: Effect of peripheral irisin overexpression (AAV8-irisin-Flag vs AAV8-GFP, injected on the day of EAE induction) on nuclear gene expression within each sorted spinal cord fraction at peak EAE. No exercise (running vs sedentary) arm was sequenced; exercise was studied only by histology/qPCR (FIG1, FIG5) and the running transcriptome comparison uses external snRNA-seq data (Sun et al., CRA007207; S9.19.p1).
planned_contrasts: NeuN+ nuclei: AAV8-irisin vs AAV8-GFP (S5.p1, FIG4b; paper: 1,017 DEGs)
NeuN- nuclei: AAV8-irisin vs AAV8-GFP (S5.p1, FIG4c; paper: 2 DEGs, Cd83 and Junb down)
paper_method: DESeq2 two-sided Wald test, BH correction, per fraction (S9.18.p1)
